correctness.rationale: By induction C_t phi at w is equivalent to phi throughout the union-equivalence graph ball of radius t; common knowledge is truth on the whole connected component. A fresh atom false only at a vertex v at maximal finite distance d proves no smaller t works, so uniform unfolding depth equals maximum component diameter (including singleton zero case). Maximum n-1 forces a spanning shortest path on all worlds with no chords, hence a spanning path. Each E_i-class must be a clique of a path, thus singleton or adjacent pair and its nontrivial edges a matching. Consequently path edges carry nonempty agent subsets S_j with S_j∩S_(j+1)=empty, and conversely these define the unique labelled frame. Count n!/2 undirected labelled paths times disjoint-adjacent nonempty subset words, giving H_(n,k)=(n!/2)u^T B^(n-2)1 for n>=3, H_(2,k)=2^k-1, H_(1,k)=1. For k>=3 each B² entry is positive, so Perron asymptotic holds; lambda3=1+sqrt(2), and k=2 alternation gives n! for n>=3. Independently enumerated disjoint-adjacent words for k=2,3,4 and n=2..6; prior source checker exhaustive small equivalence tuples was inspected, not treated as infinite proof.
